description: Bypasses the 3 XR gates in the stream path, on exact 2.0.20/5001712, 2.0.20/5001812, 2.0.21/5001968 and 2.0.22/5002244 builds.
name: Force stream XR gates

description: Adds static blue noise after video colour processing and fade, on the foveal layer only; 8-bit or 10-bit input, always 8-bit sRGB output. Selectable per layer, but turn OLED's VD-like fovea options off when combining. Unknown host shaders pass through unchanged.
name: Foveal blue-noise dithering

options.description: Both choices apply the same final 8-bit output quantizer. This describes your stream; it does not change host negotiation or decoder precision. When combining with OLED calibration, leave both of its existing VD-like fovea toggles off.
options.title: Declared input depth

description: Drains the render dispatch queue before every frame, hands scene switches to RenderDispatch.requestScene instead of the retired render runnable, and routes window teardown through the dispatch for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Frame-synced render dispatch (4XVR)

description: Only for exact 2.0.20/5001812: draws just the foveal image on a transparent 5000x6000 canvas per eye and submits it as the 2nd projection, keeping the background projection and any static trigger quad. Requires headset validation.
name: Full-FOV foveal canvas (experimental)

description: Replaces the four Quest 3 controller assets with the Galaxy XR reference models (2048x2048 textures, re-authored meshes) for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Static asset swap; headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Galaxy XR controller models (4XVR)

description: Permission-free high-resolution fix: appends a static 2x2 Android-surface compositor trigger and leaves each build's native projection layers and formats, including future RGB10_A2, untouched. No image copy. Exact builds 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363.
name: Galaxy XR high-resolution 3-projection fix

description: Installs the Khronos OpenXR loader 1.1.58, the 4XVR view-config API layer and the Galaxy XR manifest declarations (OpenXR 1.1, passthrough, hand and eye input) for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Decoded-base adaptation; headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Galaxy XR launch compatibility (4XVR)

description: Re-exposes the stock 4XVR launcher artwork under the canonical ic_launcher/ic_launcher_round names (adaptive icon plus density PNGs) and points the manifest at them, matching the Steam Link icon shape for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Galaxy XR launcher icon (4XVR)

description: Clamps the InitializeDevice refresh-rate picker floors (121.0f/91.0f -> 73.0f) so exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022 requests Galaxy XR's 72 Hz mode. Three guarded bytes in libvr4p-oculus.so; runtime application pending headset validation. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Galaxy XR refresh profile (72 Hz, 4XVR)

description: Installs the Galaxy XR face transport for the VRCFT module, per exact build: the face-tracking bridge layer (XR_FB_face_tracking2 to XR_ANDROID_face_tracking) and the FACE_TRACKING permission on the legacy targets 5001712/5001812/5001968/5002244; the tongue out/left/right/up/down transport slots (keeping Valve's native face expressions and standard TongueOut) on 2.0.23/5002363.
name: GXR face and tongue bridge

description: Installs the modified libplacebo 7.360.1 (LGPL-2.1-or-later), the 4XVR HDR bridge native and the bundled open-source notices for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: HDR pipeline payload (4XVR)

description: Loads the HDR bridge, routes the decoder output surface through it for the FP16 hand-off, detects HLG from the video MediaFormat and keeps the bridge informed of movie/seek transitions for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: libplacebo HDR pipeline (4XVR)

description: Stubs the 11 exported Oculus platform-init/entitlement/message functions in libovrplatformloader.so of exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. The reference Galaxy XR build requires the Meta platform channel to stay inert on a non-Meta runtime: without these stubs the app hangs on the splash — the OpenXR session is created but never presents its first frame (Galaxy XR on-device A/B, 2026-10-12). Meta-store VIP flows degrade. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Meta platform decoupling (4XVR)

description: Selects Steam Link's AAudio microphone processing mode. On Galaxy XR, Voice Recognition was clearer and louder than stock Voice Communication.
name: Microphone input preset

options.description: Voice Recognition was the clearest usable-level mode in Galaxy XR recordings. Voice Performance and Unprocessed were substantially quieter; Voice Communication sounded more processed.
options.title: Microphone mode

description: Applies OLED gamma/saturation calibration with 8-bit sRGB output, plus optional VD-like SDR foveal processing and a separate foveal gamma. Exact builds 5001712, 5001812, 5001968, 5002244, 5002363; visible improvement needs headset verification.
name: OLED color calibration

options.description: Selects gamma and saturation for both layers when the VD options are off, or for the base layer when a VD foveal option is on.
options.title: Calibration profile

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.50 to 2.50.
options.title: Gamma

options.description: Used by Custom profile. Allowed range: 0.00 to 3.00.
options.title: Saturation

options.description: VD-informed SDR processing for declared 10-bit input: use highp sampling, retain Valve's decoder colour correction, bypass the calibration profile on the foveal layer, and add no shader noise. The separate foveal gamma adjustment still applies. Output is 8-bit sRGB. Does not negotiate host depth or reproduce VD's raw-YUV decoder import. Mutually exclusive with the 8-bit option and separate blue-noise patch.
options.title: Fovea VD-Like Input 10 bit

options.description: Uses the same VD-informed SDR foveal processing for declared 8-bit input, retaining Valve's decoder colour correction while bypassing the calibration profile and adding no shader noise. The separate foveal gamma adjustment still applies. Output is 8-bit sRGB. Cannot recover precision already lost in the source. Mutually exclusive with the 10-bit option and separate blue-noise patch; does not negotiate host depth.
options.title: Fovea VD-Like Input 8 bit

options.description: Additional gamma on the foveal layer only, after its colour processing. 1.00 leaves it unchanged; higher values darken shadows and midtones. Try 1.02 first for a lighter foveal region. Works with either VD option or both off, before fade and optional blue-noise dithering. Background calibration and edge blending stay unchanged; this is manual compensation, not a verified seam fix.
options.title: Foveal gamma adjustment

description: Re-checks the 4XVR startup popups after the activity resumes or returns from system settings: hides the All-files-access prompt once external storage access is granted (the stock flow never re-checks the result of its 0x59E2 request) and hides the release-notes window when its saved version already covers the installed build, for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Popup refresh on resume (4XVR)

description: Removes the 4XVR premium gate on Galaxy XR, where the Meta Store cannot be reached to verify a purchase: every start forces the app's own VIP state on through ChangeCurVIPStateClear(true), the same state transition a store purchase applies, so IsMP() is true and the trial playback limiter stays off. The dead Meta-store Buy entry points re-assert the unlocked state instead of calling the native checkout; the Buy buttons are hidden in favor of the Sync slot. Exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Premium unlock (4XVR, experimental)

description: Installs the 4XVR render dispatch native (frame-synced scene queue and adaptive theater background updates) for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Render dispatch payload (4XVR)

description: Registers the bundled GxrToastContinuity helper, whose I610UEU2AZF3-gated memory-buildup fix and toast continuity keep the Galaxy XR UI pipeline warm across activity recreation, right after Main4XActivity.onCreate for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headless validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Startup and UI continuity helper (4XVR)

description: Requests hand, eye, face, microphone and Bluetooth permissions at startup on older builds. Battery settings and the splash are separate patches.
name: Startup permission requests (before 5002322)

description: Adds the Launching Steam Link splash and unmanaged VRLink startup on older builds. Requests no permissions; pick Startup permission requests for those.
name: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)

description: Adds the subtitle position controls row, the enlarged subtitle panel height, immediate config persistence on color-tab changes, the custom subtitle font load and the wrapped-cue size clamp for exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Headset validation pending. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Subtitle suite (4XVR)

description: Installs the subtitle position native library used by the 4XVR subtitle suite controls on exact 4XVR 2.0.22 build 20022. Based on @logkim1's 4XVR-GalaxyXR patches: https://github.com/logkim1/4XVR-GalaxyXR.
name: Subtitle suite payload (4XVR)

description: Opens Android's Battery usage page at startup so Unrestricted can be selected for XR streaming.
name: Unrestricted battery usage

description: Offsets the HMD OpenXR pose-query time and zeroes the exported HMD velocity fields, so head tracking leads the rendered frame. Controllers are unaffected.
name: Visual Delay Fix

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so: AArch64 MOVZ/MOVK at PLT cave adds value×1e6 ns to X2 in QSVLDeviceHmd::GetPose. Tested default: 60 ms. Allowed range: 0 to 4000 ms.
options.title: Pose offset (ms)

description: Installs the XR runtime bridge resources and extension DEX that the other XR patches need.
name: XR Core Runtime

description: Installs baseline Galaxy XR HMD, controller and default config payloads plus the dashboard bootstrap assets.
name: XR Device Config Baseline

description: Installs ui_config.json so XR pointer and button input reaches the launcher UI.
name: XR Input Routing Config

description: Builds microG Maps, a separate app (org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps.microg) that signs in to your Google account through microG: saved places and lists, Timeline, location sharing, contributions and push messages. Remove sign-in prompts, Trim account menu and Remove permissions are left out of this build, Offline saved places keeps only its Local saved screen, which copies your account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account), and its icon carries microG's C. Needs microG: MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore. Not for root (mount) installs.
name: Add microG support

description: Allows Google Maps, Android Auto, and third-party media controllers to connect to YouTube Music.
name: Allow external media browser connections

description: Adds MAIN and DEFAULT intent-filters to MusicActivity so external controllers like Google Maps can open the app.
name: Allow external media browser launch

dependencies: Allow Morphe YouTube Music package visibility
description: Enables YouTube Music and modded media apps as the navigation mini player.
name: Allow Morphe YouTube Music mini player

options.description: Package name of your modded YouTube Music app.
options.title: YouTube Music package name

description: Adds package queries and permission to AndroidManifest.xml for full media apps visibility.
name: Allow Morphe YouTube Music package visibility

description: AMOLED-black theme. Pins Maps' own dark mode and its separate navigation colour scheme, and remaps colour resources, drawable fills and draw-time paints so no surface is left grey.
name: Black theme

description: Makes Maps' bundled Play services signature and availability checks always pass, so it runs re-signed and with Play services disabled or absent, and lets it load tiles, search and routing by sending Google's own package and certificate in the identity headers the Maps backend checks. Where Play services rejects the re-signed app, Maps degrades instead of crashing.
name: Bypass Play Services checks

description: Installs alongside stock Google Maps under its own package name and adds MicroG spoofing.
name: Change package name

options.description: The package name to install under.
options.title: Package name

description: Adds a Customization row under Settings on the account sheet, with switches for the patches here that can be turned back off inside the app.
name: Customization screen

description: Elevates the right-side navigation buttons (Search, Sound, Report, Media) above the media player and bottom panel during turn-by-turn navigation in portrait mode.
name: Elevate right navigation buttons

options.description: Height in dp to elevate the right navigation buttons above the media player.
options.title: Elevation (dp)

description: Adds a Location source choice to the Customization screen: Android's own location providers, microG's (microg Services) or Google Play services' fused provider. With Android, neither is ever asked for a location. A source that is missing or disabled is never used, so location keeps working without it. Also keeps the network (Wi-Fi/cell) provider registered when no fused provider answers, instead of GPS only, so a fix does not go stale indoors.
name: Location provider toggle

options.description: The location source Maps starts with. On: the fused provider -- Google Play services', or microG's in microG Maps -- whenever it is installed and enabled, Android's own providers otherwise. Off: Android's own providers. Can be changed later on the Customization screen.
options.title: Default to Play services location

description: Brings the Pixel-only power saving mode to every phone: while driving with navigation, press the power button and Maps shows only key information such as the next turn on a black screen. Turn it on or off in Settings > Navigation > Power saving mode. Pixels that have it built in keep Google's own version unless Power saving mode is turned on in Power Saving Options, a row on the account sheet under Customization, which also has: a navigation button that opens the power saving screen without locking the phone, switching to it by itself when idle, a speedometer on it, a lower frame rate, and its black map in navigation or all over Maps.
name: Power saving mode

description: Removes permissions that only serve Google-account features or Google's data collection: background location, physical activity, contacts, microphone (voice search stops working), camera (Lens and Live View stop working), car speed, advertising ID, push messages and Google services settings. Left out with Add microG support, whose account features need them.
name: Remove permissions

description: Points the Firebase Installations and Play services compliance check-ins at an unresolvable host, stops every ad impression and click ping from being sent, and deregisters Google's logging, performance-monitoring, survey and Location History libraries and the on-device federated-learning services.
name: Remove telemetry

description: Lets a re-signed Maps load tiles, search and routing, by sending Google's own package and certificate.
name: Restore map data

description: Adds +, − and reset tiles during turn-by-turn that change the navigation zoom while the camera keeps following the car.
name: Zoom controls in navigation

description: Unlocks the premium feature set offline, without a subscription.
name: Unlock premium

description: Unlocks the premium feature set offline, without a subscription.
name: Unlock premium

description: Unlocks all device masking offline, without the paid licence app.
name: Unlock premium

description: Unlocks the premium feature set offline, without a subscription.
name: Unlock premium

description: Unlocks the premium feature set offline, without a subscription.
name: Unlock premium

description: Unlocks all device masking offline, without the paid licence app.
name: Unlock premium

description: Stop Pupil 6.1.1 checking for updates at startup and showing update prompts. Manual update checking in Settings remains available.
name: Disable automatic update checks

description: Disable the left-swipe action tray on Pupil 6.1.1 gallery cards. Preserve taps, long taps, reader gestures and vertical scrolling.
name: Disable gallery left swipe

description: Makes the background of Tumblr's Dark Mode palette black, which can save battery on OLED screens, or another dark color you pick when patching. Other palettes stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
name: Dark background color

options.description: The color the Dark Mode palette's background turns, as a six-digit color code (#RRGGBB), like #121212. Leave it blank for black. Cards get the same color and highlighted parts a slightly lighter one. Grays up to #3F3F3F work, and lighter colors are refused so text stays readable.
options.title: Background color

description: Turns off Firebase crash reports and Google's analytics collection, and Tumblr's own tracking and ad measurement once it restarts. The Firebase and Google part stays until you patch again without it. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.
name: Disable analytics

description: Stops Tumblr asking Google Play for a newer version and showing Play's update prompt. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > More settings > Updates.
name: Disable update prompts

description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Firebase can refuse a patched Tumblr whose request doesn't name Tumblr's original signature, so this sends its fingerprint. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > More settings > Notifications.
name: Fix push notifications

description: Takes ad cards and sponsored posts out of your dashboard and other feeds, and stops Tumblr asking its ad networks for more. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
name: Hide ads

description: Tumblr and the ad companies inside it see an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you'd deleted your ad ID in Android. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.
name: Hide advertising ID

description: Hides the prompts to pay for Blaze, Tumblr's way to promote a post. That covers the Blaze buttons on your blog and dashboard, the nudge after you post, and the Blaze banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
name: Hide Blaze prompts

description: Takes the tags off the bottom of posts in your dashboard, other feeds and Tumblr TV, and keeps the source link. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
name: Hide hashtags

description: Takes the like, reblog and comment counts off the footer under posts, community posts included, and the count off the top of a post's notes. The buttons stay and still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
name: Hide note counts

description: Takes photo posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with pictures and no video, its reblog trail included, counts as a photo post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
name: Hide photo posts

description: Takes posts out of your dashboard and other feeds when their text, reblog trail, tags or summary has a word or phrase from your list, ignoring case and matching whole words. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
name: Hide posts with these words

description: Takes reblogs out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads, and keeps the posts people made themselves. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
name: Hide reblogs

description: Takes the blogs Tumblr suggests you follow out of your dashboard and other feeds, whether as cards, rows or carousels, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
name: Hide suggested blogs

description: Takes the communities Tumblr suggests you join out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
name: Hide suggested communities

description: Takes text posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with no pictures or video, its reblog trail included, counts as a text post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
name: Hide text posts

description: Hides the banner on your dashboard that asks you to pay for Ad-Free Browsing. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
name: Hide the ad-free banner

description: Takes the comment button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
name: Hide the comment button

description: Takes the Communities tab out of the bottom bar and stops the Communities tips in the post editor. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
name: Hide the Communities tab

description: Hides the Premium diamond and the TumblrMart button at the top of your dashboard, Explore and notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
name: Hide the diamond and TumblrMart

description: Takes the Explore and search button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
name: Hide the Explore tab

description: Takes the Follow button out of the header of posts from blogs you don't follow yet. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
name: Hide the Follow button

description: Takes the like button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, and the reactions off community posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
name: Hide the like button

description: Takes the Notifications button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
name: Hide the Notifications tab

description: Takes the reblog button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
name: Hide the reblog button

description: Takes the Save button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, when Tumblr shows one. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
name: Hide the Save button

description: Takes the share button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.
name: Hide the share button

description: Takes the Tumblr TV tab out of the bottom bar, and stops sign-up from sending you there. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
name: Hide Tumblr TV

description: Hides the unread dots and counts on the bottom bar's Dashboard, Communities and Notifications tabs, with a switch for each tab. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
name: Hide unread dots

description: Takes video posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with a video anywhere in it, its reblog trail included, counts as a video post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
name: Hide video posts

description: Takes Tumblr TV's Watch it rows and video hub cards out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.
name: Hide Watch it rows

description: Adds a HushTumblr page where you turn features on or off, pause HushTumblr, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Tumblr's Settings or by long-pressing the Tumblr icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: HushTumblr settings

description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Tumblr, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Remove ad tracking permissions

description: Puts the bottom bar's tabs in an order you pick, from a list in its settings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
name: Reorder the bottom bar

description: Stops the pop-up that asks what you think of the Tumblr app and then asks you for a store rating or feedback. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
name: Skip review prompts

description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Tumblr's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.
name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in

description: Stops Tumblr watching for screenshots, so taking one doesn't bring up its offer to save the post as an image. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.
name: Turn off screenshot sharing

description: Changes the app package name to allow installing alongside the original.
name: Change package name

description: Raises per-category daily push caps and heads-up push limits.
name: Notification Limits Raised

description: Bypasses premium subscription checks to unlock all premium features.
name: Premium Bypass

description: Removes the 200-item local reading history limit.
name: Remove History Cap

description: Overrides daily replay listening time limits to unlimited.
name: Replay Minutes Override

description: Disables Instabug and Adjust telemetry SDKs for privacy.
name: Telemetry Kill

description: Bring back old twitter logo and name
name: Bring back twitter

description: Removes tracking parameters when sharing links
name: Clear tracking params

name: Custom download folder
